Kangana Ranaut criticizes Hrithik Roshan, mentions Saba Azad and Sonakshi Sinha

Actress Kangana Ranaut criticized actor Hrithik Roshan, referencing his partner Saba Azad and making a comment about women marrying "Islamic people" and turning "leftist." Ranaut's remarks were directed at Roshan, telling him to "stop embarrassing" Azad and to "stop adding fuel to fire." Some reports linked Ranaut's comments about women marrying Islamic people to actress Sonakshi Sinha. The context for Ranaut's remarks appears to be a response to an Instagram comment by Roshan.
